source.citation: Made-up conversation written for tests. Not real call data.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, what can I help you with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My package says delivered but I don't have it. I ordered it 4 days ago.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: If you have been waiting for less than a week, the package is sometimes marked as delivered by mistake and can still take a couple of days to arrive.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: If it still hasn't arrived after 7 days, we will ship you a new order.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, I'll wait a few more days.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sounds good. Have a nice day!

note: Held-out. Missing-item answer matching the guideline, with its 7-day condition.
